violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to apply for a RICFSM with RIDOH. Application was emailed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

Raw animal foods liquid eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods apples in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Proper food storage reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026

Lobster meat with mayo, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Per PIC, lobster meat was prepped with mayo 3 days prior to inspection. Lobster meat was placed into a fish tub in 2 door reach-in with the cover tightly on. Lobster meat was observed at 50 DF and was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026

The door to the outside, located in the take-out area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwasher. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

The floor in the basement area is in poor repair/needs to be re-sealed. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Per PIC, floor will be re-sealed next month when establishment closes for the year. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2026

The floor in the basement storage area has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (bread) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Employee voluntarily disposed of bread. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2024

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Inspector instructed staff to use dishwasher to wash and rinse but use three bay sink to sanitize until service is provided to machine. New Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2024

Clam cakes were observed held at 121-132 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. See disposal. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/11/2024

Dressing was observed held at 50 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC moved to ice bath. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/11/2024

Clam cake batter was observed held at 70 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. See disposal. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/11/2024

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/19/2024
The floor in the downstairs area underneath sinks at entrance is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2024
An employee was observed washing their hands while wearing gloves. Gloves must be removed before washing hands or in-between tasks followed by washing of hands. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (cucumbers for salad) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. contaminated food was voluntarily disposed of at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

Shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. Tags were observed without dates of last use. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

Raw animal foods (liquid eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (strawberries) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Liquid eggs were moved at time inspection to lower shelf within walk-in cooler. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. PIC instructed to use dish machine for wash and rinse only and sanitize dishes in 3 bay sink until unit is serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

Cole slaw within salad unit was observed at 64 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food was voluntarily disposed of at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

Lobster meat and lobster salad were both observed being held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Both items were prepped within 4 hours at time of inspection, items moved to walk-in cooler to reach temperature control. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

Clam strips and battered fish was observed held at 43-54 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per interview with PIC, the following corrective actions to be made; bulk of product to be held under refrigeration and taken out as needed and placed on ice bath to retain temperature. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

Lobster meat was observed thawing in walk-in cooler in reduced oxygen packaging (ROP) without piercing or slicing of packaging. ROP seafood to be pierced, sliced open, or removed from packing to reintroduce oxygen transfer. Packages of lobster meat that were observed above 38 degrees Fahrenheit were voluntarily disposed of by PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen and detached dry storage room, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/19/2024

A paper basket was observed being used as scoop for container of dry ingredients between uses. Scoops were observed in other containers throughout establishment with handles in contact with food. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024

Salad refrigeration unit was not in good repair, unit was observed held at 60 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit unable to maintain temperature below 41 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit was taken out of service at time inspection and establishment is to not use unit for TCS foods until unit is serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 07/05/2024
The floor in the downstairs area underneath sinks at entrance is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2024
